versions.title: The left-navigation reading app: Start here with Who are you, the record (the ABP, Evidence, the gap, What follows), what you do (Customise, Use it, Build it, Authorise it), what you hold (Licence, Your keys, Keep it, Download). Adds the consequence layer, the assets and routes-out, the dual licence, Your keys and the vault's own commit history. Pushed as a new app vault vbhmlulo.

Connector shapes: a whose-material column on the grant, an open-questions badge on the first screen, and three panels on the grant view — open questions, where the vendor's pages disagree, granted and not in the grammar
The renderer explains itself when opened in this vault (no vault.json here: it is the app, not a policy); the application vaults gain the sub-vault link that mounts this vault at app/
The renderer reads data/app.json for its dist manifest and names the loader that fetched it in its top bar
The renderer moves out of the application vaults into this one; every application vault keeps a loader and its data
